name: CogVideoX
tagline: Open-source text-to-video and image-to-video diffusion transformer supporting 6-second coherent motion clips locally.
real_test_summary: Tested running the quantized CogVideoX-2B and 5B pipelines locally via Diffusers and ComfyUI with CPU offloading enabled. Generates smooth 48-frame clips completely offline.
pros: 2B and quantized 5B variants run on consumer 8GB-12GB VRAM GPUs with offloading
Strong temporal consistency across 6-second action sequences
Apache-2.0 license for the 2B model with native ComfyUI and Diffusers support
cons: Sequential CPU offloading noticeably increases per-clip render times
5B model requires higher VRAM or aggressive quantization to avoid memory limits
